summary: Hiring Flow UX overhaul testing complete. All features verified: Profile Preview Modal opens on card click without backend mutations, state-driven action buttons render correctly per stage, pass/reject flow with confirmation dialogs, state reminder banners display appropriate messages, and no duplicate/conflicting CTAs.

Backend: Pipeline API returns messages_count for each candidate
Backend: Pipeline API returns certifications in seeker object
Backend: Pipeline API returns pay_range in job object
Backend: Pipeline API returns shift_type in job object
Backend: 'passed' stage is valid and accepted
Backend: Passed/rejected candidates filtered from active pipeline view
Backend: Invalid stage returns 400
Backend: Duplicate stage returns 409

Backend: Seeker access to pipeline returns 403
